items.exampleEn: The vet prescribed some medicine for our dog's sore ear.
items.exampleZh: 獸醫替我們家的狗開了治耳朵痛的藥。

items.exampleEn: My cousin works as a translator at a foreign embassy.
items.exampleZh: 我表姊在一間外國大使館當翻譯。

items.exampleEn: This coffee has a fair-trade certification.
items.exampleZh: 這款咖啡有公平貿易認證。

items.exampleEn: The zoo evacuated visitors from the area after a monkey escaped from its cage.
items.exampleZh: 一隻猴子逃出籠子後，動物園把遊客疏散離開那一區。

items.exampleEn: An expert certified that the old painting was real.
items.exampleZh: 一位專家證實那幅老畫是真跡。

items.exampleEn: The postal service raised the price of stamps this year.
items.exampleZh: 郵政單位今年調漲了郵票的價格。

items.exampleEn: The bank noticed an unauthorized payment from my account.
items.exampleZh: 銀行發現我的帳戶有一筆未經授權的付款。
items.glossZh: 未經授權的；未經許可的

items.exampleEn: The teacher penalizes late homework by taking off five points.
items.exampleZh: 老師對遲交的作業會扣五分作為處罰。

items.sentenceEn: Please write your postal code on the form.
items.sentenceZh: 請在表格上寫下你的郵遞區號。

items.audioEn: The embassy is closed on Friday for a holiday, so come back on Monday morning.
items.audioZh: 大使館星期五因放假不開，請星期一早上再來。
items.questionZh: 說話者請對方什麼時候再來？

items.sentenceEn: In the old story, the wise woman prescribes hot tea for every problem.
items.sentenceZh: 在那個古老的故事裡，那位聰明的婦人對每個問題都開出熱茶這帖藥方。

items.sentenceEn: Our cooking school is certified by a famous chefs' group.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的烹飪學校獲得一個知名廚師協會的認證。

items.stemEn: The referee will ____ any player who argues with him.
items.stemZh: 裁判會處罰任何和他爭吵的球員。

items.stemEn: Someone made ____ copies of the film without asking the company and put them online.
items.stemZh: 有人沒經過公司同意，就擅自複製那部電影並放上網路。

items.passageEn: Last month, my aunt opened a small bakery and learned a lot about rules. First, she needed a food safety certification, and an inspector had to certify her kitchen. Then a postal worker delivered her business papers, which said that the city can penalize shops that break safety rules. One day, a fire alarm went off by mistake, and she had to evacuate the shop quickly. She also put up a sign saying unauthorized people may not enter the kitchen. Her shop is also environmentally friendly, using only paper bags. Now her cakes are so popular that even workers from a nearby embassy come to buy them.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我阿姨開了一家小麵包店，學到很多關於規定的事。首先，她需要食品安全認證，檢查員也得認證她的廚房。接著，郵差送來她的營業文件，上面寫著市政府可以處罰違反安全規定的商店。有一天，火災警報誤響，她得趕快讓店裡的人撤離。她也貼了一張告示，寫著閒雜人等不得進入廚房。她的店也很環保，只用紙袋。現在她的蛋糕非常受歡迎，連附近大使館的員工都會來買。

questions.questionZh: 開店前，阿姨首先需要什麼？
火災警報響時發生了什麼事？
options: 消防員趕來檢查了很久

items.promptZh: 這間工廠的產品已經通過安全認證。
referenceEn: This factory's products have passed safety certification.
The products from this factory have a safety certification.
rubricZh: 要用 certification（例如 safety certification）

items.promptZh: 郵務人員每天早上十點左右把信送到我們這一區。
referenceEn: Postal workers deliver mail to our area at around ten every morning.
Every morning, the postal workers bring the mail to our neighborhood at about ten.
rubricZh: postal 放在名詞前，表示「郵政的」（例如 postal workers 等）
習慣的事用現在式；「送信」可寫，例如 deliver mail、bring the mail 等
「十點左右」可寫，例如 at around ten、at about ten 等
